data.name: Fadl
data.gender_notes: Fadl is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fadl is a Quranic name that refers to a gift or favor given by Allah. It signifies a blessing or a privilege bestowed upon an individual. The name Fadl carries the meaning “Gift, Favor, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fadl usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, favor, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be grateful for the blessings and favors bestowed upon us.
data.etymology: Fadl belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Favor, Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fadl total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: فضل
in_arabic.meaning: فضل يعني التفضل و الإحسان و العطاء الكثير من الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: فضل هو اسم مشتق من الفضل الذي يعني التفضل و الإحسان و العطاء الكثير من الله. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: 'والفضل بيد الله يؤتيه من يشاء' (آل عمران: 74). يعني هذا الاسم العطاء و الإحسان الذي يأتي من الله تعالى، و يدل على شكر الله على نعمه و عطائه.

in_urdu.name: فضل
in_urdu.meaning: فضل کا مطلب ہے احسان، مہربانی اور اللہ کی طرف سے عطا
in_urdu.long_meaning: فضل ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے احسان، مہربانی اور اللہ کی طرف سے عطا۔ قرآن مجید میں اس کا ذکر کئی جگہوں پر آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ آل عمران میں: 'والفضل بيد الله يؤتيه من يشاء' ۔ یہ نام اللہ کی مہربانی اور عطا کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور اس کا شکر ادا کرنے کی ترغیب دیتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ज़्ल
in_hindi.meaning: फ़ज़्ल का अर्थ है कृपा, दया और ईश्वर की ओर से उपहार
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ज़्ल एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है कृपा, दया और ईश्वर की ओर से उपहार। कुरआन में इसका उल्लेख कई जगहों पर किया गया है, जैसे कि सूरह آل عمران में: 'والفضل بيد الله يؤتيه من يشاء' । यह नाम ईश्वर की कृपा और उपहार को दर्शाता है, और इसका आभार व्यक्त करने की प्रेरणा देता है।

in_pashto.name: فضل
in_pashto.meaning: فضل د رحمت، احسان او د الله تعالی د ډالۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: فضل د عربي نوم دی چي د رحمت، احسان او د الله تعالی د ډالۍ معنی لري. په قرآن کريم کي يې د سوره آل عمران په آيت کي يادونه شوې ده: 'والفضل بيد الله يؤتيه من يشاء' . دا نوم د الله تعالی د رحمت او ډالۍ ښودنه کوي، او د هغه د شکر کولو هڅونه کوي.

in_english.name: Fadl
in_english.meaning: Fadl means bounty, kindness, and gift from Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Fadl is an Arabic name derived from the root 'F-D-L', which signifies bounty, kindness, and gift from Allah. It is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al Imran: 'And favours [are granted] by the hand of Allah: He bestows [them] on whom He wills' (3:74). The name Fadl represents the blessings and generosity of Allah, encouraging the bearer to be grateful for divine favours.

data.cultural_impact: In Arabic and Islamic cultures, the name Fadl holds a high value as it represents the idea of being favored or granted a special gift by Allah. This name is sometimes given to children as a reminder that they are blessed by Allah. It signifies the idea of being appreciated, cherished, and favored.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fadl holds deep significance as it is a reminder of the divine blessings bestowed upon us by Allah. It emphasizes the importance of recognizing and being grateful for the gifts and blessings we have received from Allah. This name encourages individuals to live in a state of gratitude, appreciating the blessings in their lives, and striving to use those blessings to serve others and fulfill their purpose. The name Fadl is a constant reminder of the favor and blessings of Allah, inspiring individuals to live a life of devotion, love, and service to Allah and His creation.
